Conditions générales

The terms that apply to every quote, order and service from Satin Graphic.

Agreement

By requesting a quote, approving a proof or placing an order with Satin Graphic you agree to these terms, our Privacy Policy and the Orders, Shipping & Returns policy. If you are ordering for a business you confirm you are authorized to bind it. Satin Graphic is operated by Satin Auto Wrap Inc. For wrap, PPF and design projects, the service or design agreement you sign for your project also applies; where it differs from these terms, the signed agreement governs.

Quotes and estimates

  • Online estimators show starting prices based on the options you select. They are not binding quotes.
  • Written quotes are valid for 30 days and are based on the information you provide. Changes to size, quantity, materials, vehicle condition or artwork may change the price.
  • Vehicle wrap, tint and window-graphic quotes are confirmed after we inspect the vehicle or measure the glass. Quotes exclude HST unless stated.

Deposits and payment

  • Print orders are paid in full before production. Wraps, installations and website projects require a 50% deposit to schedule, with the balance due on completion or before delivery.
  • For wraps, printing, material ordering and installation start only after the deposit is received. The production deposit becomes non-refundable once materials are ordered, printing begins or production starts.
  • Design deposits are non-refundable once concept work has started and are credited against the production order they were designed for.
  • We accept Interac e-Transfer, Visa, Mastercard and cheque (cleared before release). Overdue balances accrue 2% per month.
  • Finished goods remain our property until paid in full, and a vehicle may be kept at our shop until the balance is paid.

Design services

  • Standard design fee: $250 + tax, unless a Free Design promotion is written on your agreement. It covers consultation, concepts, mockups, revisions and artwork preparation and is non-refundable once work has started.
  • If you don’t supply a finished design, we create up to three (3) concepts. You choose one to develop, with up to ten (10) revisions included; extra revisions are $25 each.
  • Asking for a brand-new concept after the first concepts are delivered is a new design project with a new design fee.
  • Design starts after the design deposit and all project information (logos, photos, text, measurements) are received. First concepts can take one week or longer; timelines are estimates and depend on how quickly you reply.
  • 3D renderings are included for full and half wraps when a template for your vehicle is available; decals, partial wraps and smaller projects may have a rendering fee. Renderings are for approval only and may not show exact dimensions, colours or panel breaks.
  • AI-generated images are for inspiration only; production artwork may need to be redrawn or vectorized.

Artwork, proofs and approval

  • You are responsible for the content of the artwork you supply or approve — spelling, phone numbers, images and rights to use them. Production starts only after you approve a proof, and the approved proof is what we print.
  • We do not proofread. Errors present in an approved proof are reprinted at your cost.
  • You can ask for a printed test print before production. If you don’t, we are not responsible for colour differences between screen previews and the print.
  • Colour on screen is not a reliable guide to print colour. We match Pantone references where specified; otherwise commercially reasonable colour variation is normal and not a defect.
  • You confirm you own or are licensed to use all logos, images, fonts and text you supply, and you indemnify us against claims arising from their use.

Production and turnaround

  • Turnaround times are estimates measured in business days from proof approval and receipt of payment. We are not liable for delays caused by material availability, weather, courier performance or late approvals.
  • Print quantities may vary by up to 5% over or under, which is standard trade practice; you are billed for the quantity delivered.

Vehicle services

  • Wraps and PPF adhere properly only to factory OEM paint in good condition. We inspect and note existing damage, repaint, rust or peeling clear coat before starting, and we are not responsible for paint that lifts with the film in those areas.
  • Vehicles must arrive washed and empty of personal belongings. A cleaning fee of $100 may apply to vehicles that arrive dirty. We are not responsible for items left inside.
  • Removal of existing wraps, decals, tint or adhesive residue is billed separately, starting at $100 per labour hour.
  • Wraps cover exterior surfaces. Door jambs, inner door edges, engine bays and trunk interiors are not included unless quoted. On vans and other commercial vehicles the full roof is included only when your quote says so; otherwise we wrap about 2–3 feet of the roof behind the windshield.
  • Some textured plastics, rubber and trim do not hold vinyl well; we may leave out surfaces where we can’t guarantee the result.
  • For a cleaner finish we may remove and reinstall handles, mirrors, lights, emblems and trim. We are not responsible for brittle clips, previous repairs or hidden defects found while doing this.
  • Wrap film is printed in panels up to about 52 inches wide, so seams and overlaps on large graphics are normal and are not defects.
  • We record the vehicle’s condition at drop-off with photos and notes. Drop-off and completion dates are estimates; if the vehicle arrives late we may move the job to the next available installation slot.
  • Window tint is installed to Ontario Highway Traffic Act guidelines as we understand them; compliance with laws in other jurisdictions is your responsibility.

Cancellations and changes

Orders may be cancelled without charge until a proof is approved. After approval, cancellations are charged for work done and materials ordered. Custom-printed goods cannot be cancelled once production has started. See the Orders, Shipping & Returns policy for details.

Warranty and liability

Our workmanship warranties are described on the Warranty page and are the only warranties we give. To the extent the law allows, our total liability for any order is limited to the amount you paid for it, and we are not liable for indirect or consequential loss such as lost business or downtime.

Nothing in these terms limits rights you have under the Ontario Consumer Protection Act that cannot be waived.

Intellectual property

Artwork we create is licensed to you for the project it was created for once paid in full; source files are provided on design-service packages that include them. Ready-made wrap designs are licensed per vehicle as described on their pages. We may show finished work in our portfolio unless you ask us not to in writing.

Website use

The content of this site is ours or licensed to us. You may not scrape, copy or republish it. Prices and availability shown online may change without notice; obvious errors do not bind us.

Governing law

These terms are governed by the laws of Ontario and the federal laws of Canada applicable in Ontario. Disputes will be heard in the courts of Ontario. Questions: info@satingraphic.ca · (905) 695-9147.
